title: Ridgway High School
description: Ridgeway R-2 School District states its commitment to providing a safe and inclusive learning environment for students, however, their failure to secure your data and their failure to address this issue resulted in a breach of student and employee personal data (Social Security numbers, medical and disciplinary records) in violation of FERPA, the Colorado Student Data Transparency and Security Act (CRS 22-16-101 et seq.), the Colorado Data Breach Notification Act (CRS 6-1-716), CORA privacy exceptions, and possibly HIPAA.
